adjudication.rationale: In the new shared `MultiEmail` control (`packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`), the remove button tooltip is hardcoded as `content="Remove email"` while the component otherwise uses `useLocale()`/`t()` for UI strings (e.g., `t("add_another")`). This will display English text for that tooltip in all non-English locales, which is a user-facing i18n defect introduced by this diff.
